# DSH Studio v0.4.0

This release adds light appearance and reversible plugin switches, fixes
in-app plugin installation on Windows with NVM, and enables future updates to
download, verify and install inside DSH Studio.

## Added

- Match-system, light and dark appearance modes, persisted across restarts and applied before the first frame.
- Installed plugins can be disabled without being uninstalled and re-enabled without another download.

## Changed

- Update notices open About with localized notes, download progress and installation status.
- Tauri verifies update signatures before installing and restarting inside the app.
- Plugin details moved from a permanent side rail to a consistent dialog shared by marketplace and installed lists.

## Fixed

- Fixed plugin installation failing with exit code 1 when NVM supplied a Windows Node path carrying the `\\?\` prefix that `cmd.exe` could not search.
- Drive, UNC and volume-GUID paths are normalized into shell-readable forms and covered by Windows regression tests.
- Plugin command output is read as bytes so non-UTF-8 errors on localized Windows systems are not truncated.

## Install

Choose the installer for your platform from Assets. Users on `0.3.0` or earlier
must install this update manually; releases after `0.4.0` can update in the app.
